method: Independent standard-library scalar IoU, row and loss recount; no project imports, model imports, Torch, CUDA, SSH or weight reads. Full JSON/NDJSON records parsed; source files read and AST parsed. Saved masks/oracles recounted only.

scalar_equation_checks.outward_negative_face_definition: negative offset increases low-face outward displacement: low_final=coarse_low-reference_size*negative_offset/4

limitations: Saved native scalar mask IoUs and top-K/full256 oracle flags were recounted, not reconstructed from raw masks or full candidate boxes.

Source/receipt checks establish consistency of supplied records; training state, checkpoint bytes, remote live state, original ScanNet/ScanRefer data and upstream manifests were not independently re-read.

Supplemental primary preflight receipts and historical G publication receipts/source were directly read and linked by hashes; no original-G historical row/box/score files or checkpoint replay were performed.
